evals.prompt: Audit manifest-draft-1 in skills/map-cosai-controls/evals/fixtures/cosai-crosswalk-subset.json against compliance/cosai-crosswalk.json for CoSAI ADR-030 placement rules and active persona validity, and prescribe the compliant CoSAI components and personas.
evals.expected_output: Cross-checking manifest-draft-1 against compliance/cosai-crosswalk.json surfaces three structural and lifecycle defects: (1) wiring componentApplicationInputHandling directly to componentTheModel violates ADR-030 D11/D12 — at runtime componentTheModel is reachable solely via componentModelServing (Model Serving Infrastructure & Policy Enforcement Point); (2) wiring componentApplication directly to componentToolServer violates ADR-030 D8 and D14 — tool invocation is agent-exclusive and must traverse componentAgentNetworkPolicyEnforcementPoint -> componentAgentToolTransport -> componentToolNetworkPolicyEnforcementPoint -> componentToolInputHandling -> componentAuthorizationPolicyEnforcementPoint -> componentToolServer; and (3) personaModelCreator and personaModelConsumer are both marked deprecated=true in compliance/cosai-crosswalk.json — replace with active personaModelProvider (if training/tuning models), personaApplicationDeveloper, or personaEndUser. Grounding: input pinned to skills/map-cosai-controls/evals/fixtures/cosai-crosswalk-subset.json verified against compliance/cosai-crosswalk.json.
expectations: Flags the direct componentApplicationInputHandling -> componentTheModel edge as violating ADR-030 D11/D12 and inserts componentModelServing as sole runtime door

Flags the direct componentApplication -> componentToolServer edge as violating ADR-030 D8/D14 and prescribes the Agent Network PEP -> Agent Tool Transport -> Tool Network PEP -> Tool Input Handling -> Authorization PEP path
Flags personaModelCreator and personaModelConsumer as deprecated (deprecated=true) and recommends active personaModelProvider, personaApplicationDeveloper, or personaEndUser

evals.prompt: For manifest-draft-2 in skills/map-cosai-controls/evals/fixtures/cosai-crosswalk-subset.json, look up riskAgenticDelegationConfusedDeputy and riskMCPTransportHijacking in compliance/cosai-crosswalk.json and report their verbatim external framework mappings, mitigating CoSAI controls, and Class D FedRAMP CR-26 elevations.
evals.expected_output: From compliance/cosai-crosswalk.json: (1) riskAgenticDelegationConfusedDeputy maps externally to stride: ['ElevationOfPrivilege', 'Spoofing'], mitre-atlas: ['AML.T0053@5.0.1'], and owasp-top10-llm: ['LLM06:2025']; is mitigated by CoSAI controls including controlAgentPluginPermissions and controlAgentCredentialIsolation (at componentAuthorizationPolicyEnforcementPoint and componentFederationProxy); and in Class D requires authorization_pep=true plus NIST IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 caller identity assurance with encrypted assertions under CTL.IA.IA-05 (alongside SCG-CSO-SDF, KSI-IAM-ELP, KSI-IAM-JIT, KSI-IAM-SNU, CTL.AC.AC-06-01, CTL.AC.AC-06-02). (2) riskMCPTransportHijacking maps externally to stride: ['Tampering', 'InformationDisclosure']; is mitigated by controlInterComponentTransportSecurity (and controlComponentIdentityProvenance); and in Class D elevates CMU-CSO-UVM from Class C SHOULD to MUST active FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic modules across componentAgentToolTransport (with CTL.SC.SC-07, CTL.SC.SC-13, KSI-CNA-RNT, KSI-IAM-SNU, KSI-SVC-ASM; noting KSI-SVC-VCM omits Class D in 2026.11.02.01). Grounding: input from skills/map-cosai-controls/evals/fixtures/cosai-crosswalk-subset.json resolved against compliance/cosai-crosswalk.json.
expectations: Reports exact external mappings for riskAgenticDelegationConfusedDeputy (STRIDE ElevationOfPrivilege/Spoofing, AML.T0053@5.0.1, LLM06:2025) and riskMCPTransportHijacking (STRIDE Tampering/InformationDisclosure)
Maps mitigating CoSAI controls (controlAgentPluginPermissions, controlAgentCredentialIsolation, controlInterComponentTransportSecurity)
Highlights Class D elevations: CTL.IA.IA-05 IAL3/AAL3/FAL3 + encrypted assertions and CMU-CSO-UVM MUST FIPS 140-3 modules, while noting KSI-SVC-VCM omits Class D in 2026.11.02.01
